Home / Services / Office partitions

Office glass partitions in Winnipeg

Interior glazed partitions for offices and tenant fit-ups: framed systems, frameless glass fronts and glass doors. We work clean in finished spaces and around other trades.

Glass partitions let daylight through an office and still give people a room with a door. We install straight runs, corners, angled and segmented layouts, with swing or sliding glass doors.

The work ranges from a single glass office front to full partition lines in converted industrial and heritage buildings.

What is included

  • Glass office fronts and meeting rooms
  • Framed and frameless systems
  • Glass doors, pulls and hardware
  • Straight, angled and segmented layouts

Common questions

Framed or frameless: which do you install?
Both. Framed systems use slim aluminum or steel-look profiles; frameless fronts use glass set in floor and ceiling channels with glass doors.
What do you need to quote partitions?
A floor plan with the partition lines and ceiling heights, and the door locations. Photos of the space help.
Do you work outside Winnipeg?
Yes. We are based in Winnipeg and take projects across Manitoba.
